[EN] To Tor Exsul
[ES] A Tor Exsul
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] He'll know what to do. I hope.
[ES] Sabrá qué hacer. Eso espero.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you for coming this far.
[ES] Gracias por llegar hasta aquí.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Cerenon at Elenea Magistrate residence.
[ES] Informa a Cerenon en la residencia de los magistrados de Elenea.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Clear the rasptusk sabertooths as you search for the carriage northeast of Elenea.
[ES] Elimina a los dientes de sable rasptusk mientras buscas el carruaje al noreste de Elenea.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Nadinne at Runner's Watch.
[ES] Habla con Nadinne en Runner's Watch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sorry to bring bad news."
[ES] "Siento traer malas noticias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Tarnan at Runner's Watch.
[ES] Informa a Tarnan en Runner's Watch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
